key.format: Use lowercase words joined by hyphens and colons, like save:fortitude or skill-check.

rollOption.format: Use a namespace and a name joined by colons, like self:condition:frightened.

predicate.tooDeep: Predicates can nest at most {maximum} levels deep.

source.bookLocation: Give a page number, an Archives of Nethys link, or both.
source.aonUrl: Link to one entry on 2e.aonprd.com, like https://2e.aonprd.com/Feats.aspx?ID=1.

element.unknown: “{key}” is not a rule element Pioneer knows yet.
element.suboptionsNeedToggle: Only a toggle (toggleable: true) can offer suboptions.
element.adjustModeOrSuppress: Give a mode and a value, or suppress: true, but not both.

formula.unknownReference: “{found}” at position {position} is not a reference Pioneer knows. References look like @level, @attr.str or @prof.skill.athletics.
formula.foundryReference: “{found}” at position {position} is Foundry’s spelling. Write {suggestion} instead.
formula.referenceOutOfScope: “{found}” at position {position} reads an item’s value, which this formula has no item for.

statistic.duplicateSelector: Another statistic in this pack already uses the selector {selector}.

richText.tooDeep: Rich text can nest at most {maximum} levels deep.
richText.tooLarge: Rich text can hold at most {maximum} nodes, lists and rows together.
richText.check: {hasDc, select, yes {DC {dc} } other {}}{basic, select, yes {basic } other {}}{statistic}
richText.damage: {formula}{damageType, select, bludgeoning { bludgeoning} piercing { piercing} slashing { slashing} acid { acid} cold { cold} electricity { electricity} fire { fire} sonic { sonic} vitality { vitality} void { void} force { force} spirit { spirit} mental { mental} poison { poison} bleed { bleed} precision { precision} other {}}
richText.template: {size}-foot {shape, select, burst {burst} cone {cone} cube {cube} cylinder {cylinder} emanation {emanation} line {line} other {area}}
richText.duration: {count, plural, one {# {unit, select, round {round} minute {minute} hour {hour} other {day}}} other {# {unit, select, round {rounds} minute {minutes} hour {hours} other {days}}}}
richText.basicSave: Only saving throws (statistics starting save:) can be basic.
richText.widthOnLine: Only a line has a width; other areas have just a size.

reference.attributeModifier: The character’s modifier for that attribute.
reference.cappedDexterity: The character’s Dexterity modifier, limited by the Dexterity cap of their armor.
reference.proficiencyBonus: The proficiency bonus for that statistic: the rank bonus plus level, or 0 when untrained.
reference.proficiencyRank: The proficiency rank for that statistic, from 0 (untrained) to 4 (legendary).
reference.statistic: The base of that statistic, before its modifiers, such as the spell attack modifier in a spell DC.
reference.itemLevel: The level of the item the rule element is on.
